_comment: FX catalog — every named effect the game can play. Each record picks one built-in visual (`visual`, an id from FX_DEFS in web/src/vfx/fxCatalog.ts, or 'none' for sound-only), tunes it (`params`, only values that differ from the visual's defaults), and names the sounds played at the start (`cast_sfx`) and on impact (`hit_sfx`, names from web/src/battle/audio/Sfx.ts). Spells, items, effects, abilities and monster abilities point at a record by `fx_id`. Module-inheritable. Edited in the editor's FX page. See docs/data_dictionary/fx.md.

fx.name: None
fx.description: Explicit no-op — suppress any default visual and silence both SFX slots. Use when a record should be deliberately silent.

fx.name: Lightning Strike
fx.description: Jagged blue-white zigzag drawn from caster to target, fading out over ~280ms. Cast roar + crackling impact.

fx.name: Magic Dart
fx.description: Fast arcane orb with a sparkle trail and a bright impact ring. The classic single-target arcane projectile.

fx.name: Magic Arrow
fx.description: Glowing shaft with a bright tip, sparkle trail, and a fragmenting impact. Reads as 'magic, not mundane' on aimed shots.

fx.name: Fireball Burst
fx.description: Bowed orange projectile to the target, with an explosion sound on impact. Pair with an AOE on the destination.

fx.name: Meteor Strike
fx.description: A blazing meteor falls from the sky onto the target, trailing embers into a fiery impact burst. Same effect the Meteorfall Mace / Starfall Sling use; on an auto-monster spell one meteor drops on each foe.

fx.name: Void Orb
fx.description: A large glowing multi-coloured sphere streaks from the caster to the target, churning through a violet/magenta/cyan void palette with a spark trail, then implodes and erupts in a shockwave. For high-tier single-target void spells.

fx.name: Generic Projectile
fx.description: Slow-bowed arcane line. The default for any projectile spell that doesn't specify another animation.

fx.name: Healing Sparkles
fx.description: Rising green sparkles below the target. Use for any positive-restoration spell.

fx.name: Shield Aura
fx.description: Soft expanding gold ring around the target with a crystalline chime. Use for AC buffs / protective effects.

fx.name: Status Aura
fx.description: General gold ring + cast chime — covers neutral status applies like sleep, charm, push, light.

fx.name: Curse Aura
fx.description: Soft expanding purple ring with a chime. Use for hex / curse / debuff spells.

fx.name: Turn Undead
fx.description: Bright radial burst with a holy chord cast sound. Reserved for radiant / undead-bane abilities.

fx.name: Teleport Blink
fx.description: Soft arcane burst at the destination with a chime — pairs with the actor sprite snapping to the new tile.

fx.name: Summon Burst
fx.description: Radial burst at the spawn tile + chime. Use for animate_dead / summon spells.

fx.name: Utility Clack
fx.description: Lock-pick / mechanical SFX with no visual. Use for non-visual utility spells (knock, dispel-lock).

fx.name: Level Up Chime
fx.description: Triumphant arpeggio with a sparkle tail. Best for character-progression moments (level up, learn ability).

fx.name: Hellfire
fx.description: A roiling ball of flame hurled at the target, erupting on impact. Demon Hellfire / Lich Fireball.

fx.name: Dragon Breath
fx.description: A cone of fire pouring from the caster to the target. Dragon fire breath.

fx.name: Explosion
fx.description: A big fire-coloured radial burst on the target — fireball-style impacts.
